messages:
ajay: FYI PR #5012 shows some throughput variance in the v2 runtime benchmarks. Looking to merge this afternoon if we can get +2 reviews. Bench logs below. cc @kevin @maria :eyes:

kevin: can you paste the CI artifacts link?

ajay: buildkite: https://ci.buildkite.com/redwood/infra/5012/artifacts

ajay: bench summary:
```
workload: chat-short (seq=64)
baseline: 12.4k tok/s
pr5012: 13.1k tok/s (+5.6%)

workload: chat-long (seq=2048)
baseline: 1.1k tok/s
pr5012: 0.98k tok/s (-10.9%)

memory: baseline 6.8GB -> pr 7.1GB (+300MB)
p95 latency: baseline 42ms -> pr 48ms
``` 

maria: hmm that long-seq regression is concerning. do you have flamegraphs or pprof output? also which model config (kv vs no-kv)?

ajay: kv enabled, 6k prefixes in trace. flamegraph: https://internal-artifacts/redwood/5012/flame.svg
pprof snippet:
```
 38.1% runtime/copy
 21.0% runtime/madvise
 12.3% serving/kv_merge
``` 

liz: could this be microbatching alignment? saw similar before when batch boundary rounding changed.

ajay: yes microbatching tweak in PR; with microbatch=auto we see the hit on long sequences. if I force microbatch=1 it's back to baseline. thinking follow-up patch to guard long-seq paths.

kevin: OK. can we land if we gate long-seq with config flag and add test? we want the short-seq win.

ajay: I can add a runtime flag defaulting to old behavior for long sequences. will push a follow-up PR for cleanup. pinging for approvals: @kevin @maria

bench-bot: CI perf-run completed — artifacts uploaded (link above). regression threshold check: FAILED on chat-long (10.9% > 10% threshold).

maria: if threshold is 10% and we are 10.9 then it's failing. the guard sounds good. please include a short note in PR description about expected perf tradeoffs.

ajay: noted. I'll push a small change (comment + flag) in 15m.

kevin: I'll review once you push. can we also add a size check to avoid extra copy in kv_merge? I left a comment in PR.

ajay: saw the comment, will address in same follow-up.

maria: once guard + tests are in, I'm +1. also schedule canary after merge.

ajay: thanks — aiming to land by EOD. tagging @deploy-bot for canary when merged.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: redwood-v2-pr5012-canary at 2026-03-18T21:00:00Z

kevin: :thumbsup:

maria: :+1:
